page.layout: Running head at top left, page number at top right. One column of running text, with one marginal note on the right beside the lines "illud Homiliarum" and "natalium in-". Nothing below the text except the digitiser's watermark, which is excluded.

main_text.p: dendis scriptis, & projectam temerita-tem, ut ait Vir quidam clarissimus, qui forte sibi consuluisset, si cum Erasmo de litteris & litteratis omnibus optimè merito parciùs ac modestius egisset; pergit eruditus Pearsonius scribitque eundem Dallæum ad secundum Origenis testimo-nium elevandum suo Marte non minùs infœliciter progredi: non malè se habe-bunt res Dallæanæ, si secundum istud re-fellat argumentum æquè fœliciter ac pri-mum; Vt hoc aggrediatur Dallæus ob-servat primùm totum illud HomiliarumDall. 439.44[?] in Lucam opus Latinorum natalium in-dicijs scatere, quod probat variis in me-dium prolatis quæ ex istis Homiliis descri-psit locis; quibus omnibus respondet Pearsonius hæc esse Interpretis addita-menta, ut quoties opus erat, Versionis suæ rationem redderet; facilis responsio, si solida esset: nam quomodo quæso vera ac genuina à falsis & spuriis secernere po-terimus, in scriptorum Græcorum operi-bus, quorum Versiones Latinas tantùm habemus; Nonne Adversarius ad distin-ctionem illam Viri docti confugiet, tan-quam ad sacram Anchoram? quoties ex-ceptionibus earum consimilibus urgebi-tur, quibus utitur celeberrimus Dallæus; hæc sunt inquiet Interpretis, non autem

page.notes: Marginal note "439.44" ends in a character I could not read with certainty; marked [?]. "varijs" and "Homilijs" are printed with j for a medial vowel; I normalised these to i as the rules require. Long s is printed throughout and written as plain s. Watermark "Digitized by Google" excluded.
